These definitely aren't real players if they're teaming up with Trolls.|audio = PlsDonateWave4.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 4 ([[Pls Donate]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Troll''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Pls Donate]] as part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It had high health, higher than all enemies that appeared before it, but it was slower than the [[Guest]]. On some waves, it was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. Additionally, on some waves, it spawned with the [[Bloated]] attribute. ==Appearance== The '''Troll''' was a white humanoid with a white shirt, black jacket, pants and tie. It also had a [[wp:Trollface|Trollface]] on its head. ==Strategy== *Early game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Militant]] or [[Military Base]] can be useful against it. **The [[Military Base]] can be especially useful, as its collision damage bypasses defense. The [[Crook Boss]] also can do that with its goons, though their main source of damage is their guns. *As this enemy spawns in hordes, AOE towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful against them. **The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] can also be useful at reducing its defense, though as it is quite low this is not necessary. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} TrollWalk.gif|Walking animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PLSDONATE.png|'''Troll''' on the game thumbnail. PlsDonateBattlepassBoostThumbnail.png|'''Troll''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PlsDonateThumbnailClean.png|'''Troll''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Troll''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} TrollEnemyFace.png|'''Troll's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Troll''' was based on internet trolls. **The '''Troll''' had the iconic [[wp:Trollface|Trollface]] as it is an internet symbol to represent trolling, which is also applied on the '''Troll'''. ==Update History== *'''13 November 2024''' - [[v1.41.0]] **'''Troll''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Troll's''' defense. *'''4 December 2024''' - [[v1.44.0]] **'''Troll''' removed. {{PlsDonate|[[Guest]]|Wave 2|Troll|Wave 4|[[Trader]]|Wave 7}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
